answer.method_summary: Reads R002/R003/R004/R007/R008/R010/R013 span the majority of sites and provide the connecting backbone, so a single phase block spanning V001-V042 is defensible via read overlap chaining. Dosages were enforced exactly by construction: homozygous-alt sites (V009,V011,V018,V025,V030 dosage 4) set all four haplotypes to 1; dosage-0 (none) all 0. For heterozygous sites, alt counts across H1-H4 were fixed to the frozen dosage. Reads were clustered by allele-sharing patterns into two high-support haplotypes (the R003-like alt-rich haplotype and the R002/R007-like reference-rich haplotype) plus two low-coverage haplotypes inferred to satisfy dosage residuals. The MEC-style assignment minimized weighted mismatches: e.g., V005 dosage 2 supported by R003/R011/R012 alt calls; V006 dosage 3 with only R009 ref; V002 dosage 1 from R006 alt; V007 dosage 1 from R003/R004 alt. Sites with only single-read minority alt evidence (V004,V013,V022,V026,V029,V038,V040) are flagged uncertain as their phase across the four latent haplotypes is weakly constrained.

public_objective.notes: All 42 dosage constraints satisfied exactly by construction. Objective minimizes weighted read-vs-haplotype allele mismatches under permutation-invariant labeling. Robustness limited by low coverage on singleton-alt sites.
